description: A risk matrix showing how many risks fall into each likelihood and impact combination

title.description: Title text on top of the matrix

legend.description: Description text shown below the matrix (optional)

likelihood.description: Names of the likelihood levels, lowest first. Three to five levels are supported; the number given sets the height of the matrix.

impact.description: Names of the impact levels, lowest first. Three to five levels are supported; the number given sets the width of the matrix.

likelihoodTitle.description: Axis title for the likelihood scale (optional, defaults to 'Likelihood')

impactTitle.description: Axis title for the impact scale (optional, defaults to 'Impact')

levels.description: Risk levels of your risk method, lowest first (optional, give together with 'levelGrid'). Each level names a step of a fixed five-step colour scale, so the matrix colours follow your method instead of the position of each cell. The levels are listed in a legend beside the matrix.

name.description: Name of this risk level, shown in the legend

colour.description: Step of the colour scale: 1 green, 2 light green, 3 amber, 4 red, 5 dark red

levelGrid.description: The risk level of every cell (optional, give together with 'levels'). One row per likelihood level, lowest first; each row has one entry per impact level, lowest first. Each entry is a 1-based position in 'levels'.

cells.description: How many risks sit in each cell. Likelihood and impact are 1-based positions in the scales above. Cells you leave out are drawn in their risk colour with no count.

count.description: Number of risks in this cell

title: Report
